LinuxBox
A project by EXA Lab
Version %1$s

LinuxBox is a platform that brings Linux desktop environments to Android devices. Run distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, and Kali Linux with a complete desktop experience, designed for learning, development, customization, and exploration.

Designed to be simple and user-friendly, LinuxBox reduces the complexity of setting up Linux environments by providing ready-to-use configurations, allowing users to focus on learning and creating instead of troubleshooting setup.
